title: inquiry-customer-goal/v3
description: One row per CUSTOMER GOAL, not per frozen resolution goal — the unit changed for one row and one reason. A message can carry more than one goal, and one of the 72 ranks its two requests ('send just the nozzle; if that is impossible, refund me'), so that frozen row emits two goals joined by a customer-stated FALLBACK. Every class is adjudicated: no row is open. Rows whose adjudicated goals no longer follow from the frozen row carry a declared legacy_conflict; the frozen resolution gold is NOT re-derived here.

q.description: the case id, as the resolution gold names it

goal.description: the FROZEN resolution goal id this row came from. Two customer goals may share one.

gid.description: this customer goal's own id within the case. Equal to `goal` except where one frozen row split; the second goal of the split row carries a suffixed id.

emits_goal.description: false only for the one row the product owner ruled NO_GOAL. The row stays in the corpus so that a goal predicted on it is countable as invented.

requested_outcome.description: null exactly when emits_goal is false. There is no 'unlabelled' value in v3: every row is decided.

referent.description: what the goal is about, bound to a registry entry. UNRESOLVED is a real answer and not a parse failure; no row in v3 carries it.

basis.description: on what evidence the goal is attributed to the customer. There is no UNSTATED: a goal with no stated or directly implied outcome is not emitted, and absence is the observable.

explicit_constraints.description: how many values the customer actually said. A COUNT: the words themselves stay in the capture.

no_goal_reason.description: set exactly when the product owner ruled NO_GOAL. NOT "ignore" — the case may still raise VOC/complaint signals elsewhere in Reviewnary.

fallback_of.description: the gid this goal is the customer-stated fallback of. A goal with this set was asked for ONLY IF that one cannot happen, and no observation in this runtime establishes that — so it is never attempted. The condition's own words are customer text and stay in the capture.

has_fallback.description: the gid the customer named as this goal's fallback, if any

gold_closing_authority.description: carried from the frozen plan gold so the two representations can be compared row by row

gold_steps.description: the frozen required capabilities, carried so the conflict is checkable and so the DECISION prerequisite audit can be recomputed

gold_terminal.description: the frozen expected terminal, carried unchanged

legacy_conflict.description: how the frozen resolution-gold row stopped following from the adjudicated goals. CLOSER_MOVES: a different authority ends it. SCOPE_MOVES: the same authority, a different instance. GOAL_SPLITS: one frozen row, two customer goals. Declared, never suppressed, and never silently re-derived.
